title: Fourier one norm of a term indicator
statement: For every conjunction $T$ of literals on $n$ coordinates, the Fourier one norm of its indicator function—the function equal to $1$ where $T$ evaluates to $-1$ and $0$ elsewhere—is $1$.
hypotheses_covered: $T$ is a conjunction of literals on $n$ coordinates with distinct coordinates
